TAKE THE GAME HOME. Install Scattered Dad Adventures: it plays offline and your saves stay put.

PUT THE GAME ON YOUR HOME SCREEN

Safari tidies away website saves after a while. A Home Screen game keeps them, and plays without Wi-Fi.

  1. Tap Share ⇧ in Safari's toolbar.
  2. Scroll down and tap Add to Home Screen.
  3. Tap Add, then open the game from its new icon.

Your saves here do not move by themselves: use Save Backup (How To screen) to carry them over.
